I will keep this sorghum plot mostly low-input because money is tight and here in Mtwara we depend on the rains. I can use some manure if I get it, but I will plant my usual local seed, not buy fertilizer, and I will not irrigate. My family will do most of the work by hand, and I may hire a few labor days for heavy work like land preparation or weeding.
